title: City Gulls
description: A yellow-legged gull (Larus michahellis) stands on a wall painted with gull artwork in Rome, Italy. Small colonies of these birds often take advantage of the city’s tall buildings for nesting, roosting, and perching. During the COVID-19 pandemic, residents routinely left dry pet food out on ledges of these buildings, allowing gulls to thrive alongside people in this urban environment.
translated_description: 一只黄腿鸥（Larus michahellis）站在意大利罗马一面绘有海鸥艺术画的墙上。这些鸟的小型群落常常利用城市的高楼来筑巢、栖息和停歇。在新冠疫情期间，居民们经常把干宠物食品放在这些建筑的窗沿上，使得海鸥得以在这座城市环境中与人们共同繁衍生息。
